chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: … › Business Requirement
chunks.text:
Currently, after ASN (Advance Shipment Notice) confirmation, invoicing or disbursement requests are created manually. This results in:
• Delays in invoice generation
• Missed billing timelines
• Revenue recognition lag
• Dependency on manual tracking
The business requires automatic generation of a Disbursement Request / Invoice Draft immediately after ASN confirmation.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: … › Purpose
chunks.text:
This enhancement will:
• Automate post-shipment billing
• Improve cash flow cycle
• Reduce manual intervention
• Ensure timely customer invoicing
• Maintain alignment between logistics and finance
Shipment done → Billing initiated. No loose ends.

chunks.title: Scope
chunks.heading: … › Scope
chunks.text:
This enhancement applies:
• Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice
• Provision to create the Advance payment request against Sourcing ASN.
• Automation of Concept & Validation based on Matrix of APR & Supplier Invoice.

chunks.title: Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice
chunks.heading: … › Solution › Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice
chunks.text:
A new matrix will be added under Company setup > FA Setting based on setting “Enable automation for APR & Invoicing using PO, ASN & GRN”:
New automation rule will be triggers based on below given criteria:
• Category: All the system’s category such as Apparel, Textiles/fabric, Trims etc.
• Supplier: All the supplier belong to the specific category will be reflected with ALL selection and multiple Supplier selection option.
• Trigger Document Type:
• Advance Payment Request
• Supplier Invoice
• Document Type: Dependent on Trigger Document Type
• For Advance Payment Request:
• Against PO
• Against Sourcing ASN
• For Supplier Invoice
• Against GRN – for both GIN, ASN, & PO
• Trigger Point: It is dependent on Document Type
• APR Against PO
• PO Date
• APR against ASN
• ASN Created On
• ASN ETD Date
• ASN ETA Date
• Supplier Invoice against GRN
• Doc Date
• GRN Date
• Automation Type: Automation Frequency and setup
• Specific date in a month: In this case all the document before this date of that month will be used for automation of Invoice and will be saved in the respective list such as APR-List or Supplier Invoice with Remarks as automation (in the log)
chunks.locator: § … › Solution › Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice

chunks.title: Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice
chunks.heading: … › Solution › Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice
chunks.text:
• Each Number of days: In this scenario, a specific number of days will be defined to automate the invoicing process. Let say Number of days is defined as 5. So, every 5 days system will automatically pick all the document and create the document automatically whether APR or Supplier Invoice.
• Every End of the Day: In this type, system will create the invoice automatically at the end of the day.
Validation & Working Conditions:
• One Supplier can have only one kind of validation.
• System should show alert if user is trying to create another validation.
• Every new validation will work from next tomorrow morning.
• These Documents will be drafted in “Saved Status”
• All those Documents will not be available for next transaction which can be APR or Supplier Invoice.
chunks.locator: § … › Solution › Introduction of Automation of Advance Payment Request & Supplier Invoice (part 2)

chunks.title: Provision to create the Advance payment request against Sourcing ASN
chunks.heading: … › Solution › Provision to create the Advance payment request against Sourcing ASN
chunks.text:
Currently, there will a new provision to be introduced in the system to create the Advance Payment Request (APR) against ASN.
Advance Type will be Against Sourcing ASN which will be enabled from report rights and User program permission.
Approval matrix will be applied on this Type as well.
Advance Type: Against ASN
Navigation: FA > Account Payables > Supplier Advance Payment Request
Based on the selection of advance type as “Against ASN” and Supplier, a grid will be updated below as “ASN List”.
Header fields will be:
• Advance Type
• Supplier
• Request Date
• Advance Amount
• Invoice Number – Non-Mandatory
• Estimated Pay Date
• Bank Account
ASN selection Pop-up will have:
• Supplier Name
• Style Name & BSR – Comma separated if multiple & remove duplicate values
• OC No. - Comma separated if multiple & remove duplicate values
• Buyer Order Ref - Comma separated if multiple & remove duplicate values
• ASN No.
• ASN Date
• Custom Declaration No.
• Customer Declaration Date
• Shipping Bill No.
• Shipping Bill Date
• ETD Date
• ETA Date
• PO No. - Comma separated if multiple & remove duplicate values
• Shipped Qty
• Gross Shipped Value
• Net Shipped Value
ASN List will have:
ASN selection Pop-up will have:
• Supplier Name
• ASN No.
• ASN Date
• Custom Declaration No.
• Customer Declaration Date
• Shipping Bill No.
• Shipping Bill Date
• ETD Date
• ETA Date
chunks.locator: § … › Solution › Provision to create the Advance payment request against Sourcing ASN

chunks.title: Provision to create the Advance payment request against Sourcing ASN
chunks.heading: … › Solution › Provision to create the Advance payment request against Sourcing ASN
chunks.text:
• PO No. - Comma separated if multiple & remove duplicate values
• Net Shipped Value
• Previous Requested Amount
• APR Request Amount
Validation & Conditions:
• After the APR is created against the ASN then next time if user is trying to create the APR, then system should show the figures while creating the Request.
• If APR is created against POs, then system should restrict the APR creation against ASN or allowed for Partial amount.
• APR Values should be less than Overall PO & ASN Values.
